description.value:
If you have the @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.3QPFSY40NDIM3XL9]{Element Flail} zhier racial trait, increase the damage of the tail natural weapon by one die size.

  • Otherwise, you have a tail with a vibrant tuft of fur at its tip. You can swing it at targets as a natural weapon flail. This weapon has the Finesse property and deals 1d4 radiant damage. On impact, it sears your target and scatters specks of sunlight.
